{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Shutdown Field Neutraliser''' is a class 0F utility module designed to prevent known Thargoid shutdown pulses from disabling human ships. Aegis developed the module from work by [[Elvira Martuuk]] and placed it into service in 3303.<ref name="frontier-origin">Frontier Developments: [https://community.elitedangerous.com/galnet/28-OCT-3303 ''Capital Ships Vulnerable to Thargoid Attack''], 28 October 3303; [https://community.elitedangerous.com/galnet/24-APR-3309 ''Aegis Trials Tech to Explore Maelstroms''], 24 April 3309.</ref>

== Operation ==

The neutraliser must be activated manually. Assign it to a fire group or control binding, then hold the control as the incoming shutdown wave reaches the ship. Releasing the control or exhausting the SYS capacitor ends the protection, so the field must remain active until the wave has passed.<ref name="operation">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Shutdown_Field_Neutraliser Shutdown Field Neutraliser], Elite Dangerous Wiki, accessed 2026-09-20; [https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/thargoid-shutdown-field-neutraliser.613374/ Thargoid shutdown field neutraliser], Frontier Forums, accessed 2026-09-20.</ref>

The module takes one second to reach full charge. Its protected area expands around the equipped ship during that charge and reaches a maximum radius of 3 km, allowing nearby ships inside the field to remain online as well. It does not need to be aimed at the Thargoid or the wave.<ref name="edsy-data">[https://github.com/taleden/EDSY/blob/9cd829062217036184ea9ec79ee30934d235aca8/eddb.js#L2930 EDSY module database: Shutdown Field Neutraliser], commit <code>9cd8290</code>, accessed 2026-09-20.</ref><ref name="operation" />

Activation rapidly consumes energy from the [[Power Distributor|SYS capacitor]]. Moving pips to SYS improves recharge while the neutraliser is held, but it does not remove the need to time the activation. Triggering too early can leave the capacitor empty before the wave arrives. After the module is released or depleted, it has a ten-second cooldown before it can be used again.<ref name="operation" /><ref name="edsy-data" />

The price is the base module value. Station discounts and other modifiers can change the amount shown in Outfitting.

== Acquisition ==

The Shutdown Field Neutraliser is ordinary credit-purchase equipment in Outfitting and does not require a Technology Broker unlock. Station stock varies; EDSM's outfitting search can be used to locate a recently reported 0F module.<ref name="edsm-data">[https://www.edsm.net/en/faq/outfitting/index/id/3/name/Utility+Mount/sub/Experimental Experimental utility mounts], EDSM, accessed 2026-09-20.</ref>

== Engineering ==

The module has no Engineering blueprints or Experimental Effects.<ref name="operation" /> Engineering the ship's Power Distributor can change SYS capacity and recharge performance, but it does not modify the neutraliser itself.

== Relationship to the Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser ==

The Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser is a separate, amplified derivative designed for the energy wave once found inside a Thargoid Maelstrom. It has different specifications and acquisition rules. Those details do not apply to the standard Shutdown Field Neutraliser.<ref name="frontier-origin" />
